mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_funding_allocation(order_refund_id, order_id, customer_id, settlement_customer_id, source_method, source_id, source_principal, allocated_amount, status, source_succeeded_at, sort_order, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{orderRefundId}, #{orderId}, #{customerId}, #{settlementCustomerId}, #{sourceMethod}, #{sourceId}, #{sourcePrincipal}, #{allocatedAmount}, #{status}, #{sourceSucceededAt}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (order_refund_id, source_method, source_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM refund_funding_allocation WHERE order_refund_id = #{refundId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY sort_order, id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM refund_funding_allocation WHERE order_refund_id = #{refundId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(allocated_amount), 0) FROM refund_funding_allocation WHERE source_method = #{sourceMethod} AND source_id = #{sourceId} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_funding_allocation SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_source_id = #{resultSourceId}, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'FAILED') AND deleted = FALSE

UPDATE refund_funding_allocation SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND deleted = FALSE
